convert.normalization_limit: Text/source-interface comparison only; not new Lean or machine-code equivalence.
convert.public_source:
@[inline] def convert (u : UInt32) : Float32 :=
  let a := R2W01b.magnitude u
  if decide ((0x0bffffff : UInt32) ≤ a - 1) then
    if decide (a < (0x7f800000 : UInt32)) then
      R2W01b.tableProduct u
    else
      Float32.ofBits u
  else
    if decide ((0x00800000 : UInt32) ≤ a) then
      lowNormalDecode u
    else
      Float32.ofBits u
convert.local_source:
@[inline] def convert (u : UInt32) : Float32 :=
  let a := R2W01b.magnitude u
  if decide (0x0bffffff ≤ a - 1) then
    if decide (a < 0x7f800000) then
      R2W01b.tableProduct u
    else Float32.ofBits u
  else
    if decide (0x00800000 ≤ a) then lowNormalDecode u
    else Float32.ofBits u
